scope: Private ICE/DTLS datagram I/O fault isolation on Linux loopback
checks: An unreachable higher-priority ICE candidate does not close a peer using the viable candidate
Recoverable receive errors use cancellable exponential backoff, bounded at one second
An irrecoverably closed interface does not close a connection using another viable interface
Oversized unauthenticated datagrams are dropped before protocol processing and authenticated packets continue in both directions
All closed interfaces fail the peer promptly to permit route fallback
Peer ID and fingerprint validation and both Go compatibility roles still pass
limitations: Controlled loopback tests do not prove physical LAN/WAN throughput or dynamic network-handoff behavior
Path MTU adaptation and bandwidth-based route selection remain unfinished
No production deployment, client upgrade or physical 10 GiB benchmark occurred
